bing_cn.description: Keyless standard MCP search server using Bing's mainland China RSS endpoint
bing_cn.routingGuidance: Discovery fallback only for candidate-declared identifiers. Search hits are leads, never verified candidate facts; fetch the selected exact URL before citing it. Do not search after an exact declared URL returns 404.

fetch.description: Official MCP reference fetch server; candidate-declared public URLs only
fetch.routingGuidance: First choice for every candidate-declared exact URL, including github.com, because the CN ECS runtime probe is currently reachable. A 404 means the exact declared page is unavailable; do not follow it with a same-name web search.

context7.description: Context7 public MCP for current library and framework documentation
context7.routingGuidance: Copilot-only. Use for current library/API documentation questions; never treat library docs as evidence about a candidate.
